svg.aria-label: Left: buffer current, the plate after step 1, with row 1 at 25. The 4 neighbors of cell (2, 2) are outlined: 25 above, 0 below, 0 left, 0 right. An arrow leads to buffer next on the right, where cell (2, 2) receives 6.25. A note counts 4 reads from global memory and 1 write.
svg.text: Cell (2, 2) in step 2: 4 reads from global memory, 1 write.
Thread (2, 2) reads only buffer current and writes only its own cell of buffer next: 4 reads, 1 write.
